title: eval-harness: add CI hook for prompt-set regression gating and GitHub check integration
author: Maya Chen
description:
Context: We need an automated CI-level guard that runs a lightweight eval-harness job for PRs changing prompts, model configs, or evaluation code. This PR adds a GitHub Actions job and a reusable CI hook that runs configured prompt-set regression checks and reports a GitHub check with pass/fail and annotated examples. Motivation: prevent regressions in prompt quality and surface silent degradations before merges into main.

What this PR does:
- Adds a reusable CI hook: eval-harness/ci/hooks/prompt_regression_ci_hook.py which runs a targeted subset of eval-harness prompt sets (configurable via .eval/config.json) and computes metric deltas against baseline metrics stored in eval-harness/fixtures/baselines/*.json.
- Adds a GitHub Actions workflow .github/workflows/eval-gate.yml that invokes the hook on PRs touching evaluated paths or when the label "run-eval-gate" is present. The workflow uploads the JSON result artifact and posts a GitHub Check with a short summary and up to 5 failing examples.
- Integrates metric gating: configurable thresholds per metric (exact-match, F1, BLEU-like score) and a tolerance window. If any prompt set exceeds its regression threshold, the GitHub check fails and blocks merge (unless bypass label is applied).
- Adds tests: eval-harness/tests/test_ci_hook.py with unit tests for threshold logic, retry/backoff behavior, and synthetic prompt-run fixtures.
- Docs: redwood-docs/docs/eval-gating.md describing how the gating works, how to configure thresholds, and how to add new prompt sets to the CI.

Checklist:
- [x] Add CI hook and workflow
- [x] Unit tests for key gating logic
- [x] Documentation update and example config
- [x] Smoke-tested on a fork (see ci runs)

Notes and constraints:
- The hook runs a small, fast subset by default (per-prompt timeout 5s, max 50 examples) to keep PR latency acceptable. A full nightly job still exists for full-suite evals.
- Baselines are versioned; the workflow pins to redwood/eval-harness@main for baseline reads and creates an artifact containing the run results and computed deltas.

Related: ENG-1423 (eval gating design), ENG-1489 (CI check integrations).

Add GitHub Actions workflow eval-gate.yml and artifact upload
Docs: add eval-gating.md and example config
Fix: add retry/backoff for flaky prompt runs and improve logging
review_comments: Ethan Brooks: Overall looks good — can we ensure the hook has deterministic random seeds when sampling examples? Flaky runs will kill trust.
Maya Chen: Added deterministic seeding and an env var to override for stress runs (see last commit).
Priya Kapoor: Can we avoid blocking patch releases? Suggest an allowlist label 'bypass-eval-gate' for urgent fixes.
Maya Chen: Added support for 'bypass-eval-gate' label. The workflow still records the evaluation artifact but marks the check as neutral when label present.
Diego Morales: Test flakiness observed in initial CI run — a single example timed out intermittently. Requested retry/backoff in the hook.
Maya Chen: Implemented exponential backoff with 2 retries and added per-example timeout telemetry. Reran CI and verified stabilization.
merge_summary: Squash-merged with commits consolidated; CI gate now runs on PRs touching evals/prompts and reports a GitHub check. Added docs and tests.
release_notes: Add CI-level prompt-set regression gating: GitHub Actions job + eval-harness hook. Default is a fast subset; use nightly for full-suite checks.
